answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, and bind it to one verifiable work thread: completed jobs, peer ratings and dispute history that follow the identity and decay when idle. A Sybil farmer must fund and age each fake separately, like planting a whole orchard in tundra soil — slow and costly — while each clone thread stays thin and unproven, so the network caps new identities at tiny trade volume until their thread thickens.
